data.name: Private 3 Hour Island Sandbar Tiki Cruise
data.headline: All Ages • 3 Hours • Up to 6 passengers
data.description:
#Have some Tiki Fun in the sun and hang out with the locals on a Sandbar! 				

Enjoy the beautiful scenic views of Sarasota Bay. 3 hours of Fun in the Sun, cool off with a dip in the water and explore Big Pass Sandbar with a cocktail in hand!					

##More info
This trip is a private tour for up to 6 guests. 
Smoking is not permitted on board.
data.cancellation_notes: Tickets for Gilligan's Tiki Tours are non-refundable. Changes to the reservation may be made up until 3 hours prior to the tour time.
